en: A colorized panoramic view of a historic European town built on a hill above a river. In the foreground is a winding river bordered by rocky banks and greenery. Above it stand tightly packed houses with red-tiled roofs. On the hilltop rises a large fortified complex with long stone buildings and towers, alongside church spires and other medieval-looking structures. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. In the upper left corner, the word "Bautzen." is printed in red.
